purpose: Validate one-shot asynchronous preparation and conditional execution without stopping live sensing; report refusals and fresh forecast coverage. No retention or task-success acceptance.
requiredChecks: Keep all refusals and failures in decision denominator
At most one preparation and conditional execution attempt per decision
A consumed token cannot execute twice
Worker compares the complete prepared frame immediately before calling body.execute without yielding
A different frame refuses execution and returns actual waiting-time passive events
Never grant forecast success or refutation credit to a refused or stale action
Prepare/execute diagnostics must match recorded event starts and decision forecasts
Prediction and recording leave long-term learned state unchanged except real passive/action events
Preserve immutable source/build/harness identities, raw windows, original failure logs and stopped world
Do not change existing test assertions, goal tolerances, timing budgets or runtime world to force protocol acceptance
reportedMetrics: prediction errors and supported interval widths where supported
acceptanceBoundary: Protocol invariants and empirical availability are separate. Zero accepted actions cannot establish availability. An eight-decision smoke test cannot establish a production coverage threshold, original-data comparison, retention, transfer, multistage planning or long-run budgets.
